links.passage: Additionally, automated drip irrigation scheduling using these closed real-time sensor loops showed a 45% reduction in pumping energy costs. Controlled deficit irrigation guided by these sensors simultaneously increased the total soluble solids (TSS) of the collected fruits by 15–22% due to optimised plant water-stress management. Energy consumption is reduced because pumps are activated only when necessary, thereby promoting sustainable fruit production despite climate fluctuation (Sharma and Shivandu, 2024; Yadav et al., 2023).
